chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Validity of IEC for EOUs / SEZs

business_rules.rule_description:
2.11 Validity of IEC for EOUs / SEZs
An IEC will remain valid irrespective of a firm’s status as a DTA unit or an SEZ unit or
an EOU/EHTP/STP/BTP unit.
